paragraphs.text: Norritts are a type of imp from Dominaria .

Norritts are small, evil creatures, likely to inhabit old mansions, castles, and rundown churches. They are known for their ability to taunt even the most strong-willed warrior into a rage, and are skilled in leading their victims into death traps and ambushes. Norritts are often in league with Prodigal Sorcerers and can double the power of those they serve. The Norritt also works wonders with big blue fish, such as Island Fish Jasconius .
Norritt was created as an updated version of Nettling Imp . It was nicknamed "Ig" in development.
